name: Japanese Buildings, Floors and Rooms
description: What follows the block: a building's name, its floor (階, F, 地下, B1F) and a room (号室, 号, #, or a fourth number). Original case written for this corpuss, with made-up building names; shapes follow Japan Post's guidance on writing an address (郵便番号・住所の書き方), described in our own words; nothing copied.
